_**Agent (gpt-5.6-sol 2026-09-13 17:48:45Z)**_

Confirmed root cause: the production minifier emits:

```css
@supports(background-clip:text) or(-webkit-background-clip:text)
```

Chrome treats `or(` as an invalid token sequence and discards the entire gradient block. A Chrome CSSOM probe against the exact deployed stylesheet found no parsed `CSSSupportsRule`; computed title styles remained solid black with no background image.

The stylesheet is otherwise brace-balanced. The fix should avoid `or` in this `@supports` condition, such as separate support blocks or a single WebKit-compatible feature test.
